SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nairobi

2. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   B. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.

3. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   C. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.
   D. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.
   C. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.

5. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.
   B. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..
   D. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.
   B. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.

7. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.
   B. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.

8. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Measure rainfall only

9. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   B. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   D. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.
   C. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.
   D. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.
   B. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.
   C. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Avoid saving forever

13. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   B. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.
   C. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.

15. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing The School.
   D. Treat The School as rumours only.

16. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Destroying road signs

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Peace and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Child Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Democracy in school and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Community Leadership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain The County Governments in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Compass Direction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
